pk/social.text: Uses symbols and takes on pretend roles
Demonstrates an understanding of self, family and a diverse community
Demonstrates an understanding of the relationship between people and the environments in which they live
Demonstrates an understanding of time as it relates to self, family and community
Expresses a variety of feelings and learns to manage them
Recognizes the feelings and rights of others and responds appropriately

pk/language.text: Uses conventional conversational and other social communication skills
Demonstrates comprehension of printed materials read aloud
Hears and discriminates the sounds of English and/or home languages
Understands the purpose of writing and drawing

pk/math.text: Demonstrates knowledge of numbers and counting
Demonstrates knowledge of volume, height, weight and length

pk/science.text: Investigates characteristics of Earth and space
